# Trading Direkt 2026-09-15 | Nordnets C-H Söderberg kommenterar marknaden, Tobbe med TA

**Feed**: trading-direkt  
**Published**: 2026-09-15  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Nordnet's savings economist Carl-Henrik Söderberg discusses rising long-term rates (US 10-year near 5%), an expected Fed hike, oil above USD 100 and inflation worries. He argues that strong earnings growth is what is holding the market up, which makes Q3 reports a key test. He favours banks and select construction stocks, is cautious on engineering, and says real estate and First North small caps need lower rates and calmer markets to recover. Tobbe Rosén's technical analysis is short-term cautious on OMXS30, DAX and US indices because of lower highs, but he stays positive on the long-term trend into year-end. He is very positive on Embracer and negative on Electrolux Professional.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 EMBRAC-B — Embracer | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

TA host very positive; strong volume balance, though overbought near 88 resistance.

#### Reasoning

Tobbe Rosén (TA host) is very positive. The rise has been neat but parabolic, and the price is 10% above the upper Bollinger band near tough resistance around 88, so a pullback or retest is likely. Volume balance is very positive, so he expects buyers to absorb selling and the stock to stay buyable.

#### Sell Triggers

- rejection at 88 resistance followed by a deeper pullback
- volume balance turns negative

> *"Så jag är mycket positiv till Embracer."*

---

### ⛔ EPRO-B — Electrolux Professional | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Broke rising channel, below all MAs, heading to 42-43 kr support; no positive candle yet.

#### Reasoning

Price is below MA20/50/100/200 and sellers are in control. The stock is oversold (Stochastics under 8, RSI 35). Tobbe would only act on a positive candlestick reversal at the 42-43 kr support, using a tight stop.

#### Sell Triggers

- positive candlestick reversal above 42 kr support

> *"Men än så länge så är jag fortfarande negativ till Electrolux Professional."*

---

### 🟡 HUNT — Hunter Group | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Extremely parabolic, pullback likely, but no reversal yet; hold with trailing stop.

#### Reasoning

Overbought: in 11 of 14 past cases with readings like this, the price was lower a week later. With no reversal yet, Tobbe says holders should use a bar-by-bar exit (a weak close or a break of the prior day's low) and expects buyers to return at a higher low.

#### Sell Triggers

- close below prior day's low
- long candle closing in lower half

> *"sitter man i position så tycker jag ju att min exit strategi bar by bar är alldeles utmärkt att använda här"*

---

### 🟢 IMP-A-SDB — Implantica | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

New higher low after report spike reversal; slightly positive, continuation patterns buyable.

#### Reasoning

The report spike of nearly 50% largely reversed, but the price then made a new higher low and the trend leans upward. Choppy trading is likely after such long candles. Tobbe says positive continuation patterns are buyable.

#### Sell Triggers

- break below 56 kr low, target 52 kr (MA200)

> *"jag är ändå lite svagt positiv till implantika så som det ser ut"*

---

### 🟠 INVE-B — Investor | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lower high, testing MA100 near 390; slightly negative short/medium term, positive long term.

#### Reasoning

Fell back from above the channel, made a lower high and is below MA20/50. Stochastics MACD crossed below zero with no sign of momentum easing, so this may be the start of a five-wave decline. Tobbe would buy on a positive continuation pattern at support (MA100 near 390 or the channel floor).

#### Sell Triggers

- break below 388-390 and the rising channel floor

> *"Jag är positiv till Investor på lång sikt, men på kort och medellång sikt är jag då lite svagt negativ nu"*

---

### 🟠 META — Meta | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

At falling resistance, overbought; wait for gap fill and higher low before buying.

#### Reasoning

Overbought with a negative mini-divergence in Stochastics, wide Bollinger bands and a stretched price. A breakout bought now risks being false. Tobbe expects a short-term pullback, then a positive one-month outlook after a retest that sets a higher low.

#### Sell Triggers

- pullback fails to make a higher low

> *"Att köpa ett utbrott här så är det ganska stor risk att det utbrottet blir falskt."*

---

### 🟡 NVDA — Nvidia | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Testing MA100 at 207-208; may drop to 200; long-term positive.

#### Reasoning

Fell back from tough resistance. If 207-208 does not hold, Tobbe expects at least 200, but he remains positive long term. The chip sector is weak on AI concerns.

#### Sell Triggers

- break below 200 USD

> *"Annars är jag positiv på lång sikt. fortfarande till NVIDIA."*

---

### 🟡 SAND — Sandvik | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Long-term uptrend but fifth failed breakout, testing MA200; 360 kr zone must hold.

#### Reasoning

There is a negative cross in Stochastics MACD. A fall below the rising support line would risk a more lasting top. Tobbe calls it neutral, perhaps slightly positive.

#### Sell Triggers

- break below the 360 kr zone and the rising support line

> *"Och neutral för tillfället i Sandvik, kanske lite, lite svagt positiv."*

---

### 🟠 SOBI — Sobi | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Descending triangle, sell signal; negative short/medium term, positive long term.

#### Reasoning

The pattern looks more like a descending triangle, which usually breaks down, than a falling wedge. Stochastics MACD gave a sell signal at the zero line, though negative momentum is easing slightly. The long-term trend is up.

#### Sell Triggers

- breakdown below the triangle floor

> *"På lång sikt är jag positiv till Sobi, men på kort och medellång sikt är jag då något lite mer negativ."*

---

### 🟠 TSLA — Tesla | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Below MA200 in a falling channel, overbought; expects one or two more dips.

#### Reasoning

Price reached MA100 and filled the gap, but it is overbought with negative divergence and stuck in a range. Tobbe expects choppy trading before a direction emerges, likely with more dips first.

> *"så tycker jag att det är mer som ser ut som att priset ska ner någon eller ett par svängar till"*

---

### 🟡 8TRA — Traton | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Rising trend at trendline/MA100 support; positive medium/long term, neutral short term.

#### Reasoning

Price is near the rising trendline, which coincides with MA100, and near the lower gap support. Tobbe expects sideways chop for a while.

#### Sell Triggers

- break below the rising trendline/MA100 and the gap support

> *"Jag är positiv på lång medellång sikt, men på kort sikt så är jag nog mer åt det neutralt."*

---

### 🟠 VOLV-B — Volvo | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Rising trend but pullback broke short/mid MAs; likely down to the channel floor.

#### Reasoning

MA200 still points clearly upward, but Tobbe sees no sign of buyers returning and expects a further move toward the rising channel floor.

#### Sell Triggers

- break of the rising channel floor

> *"ganska stor risk för att priset behöver ner kring golvet i den här stigande kanalen"*

---

### 🟢 AXFO — Axfood | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Cited analysts upgraded to buy (incl. Handelsbanken); Nordnet customers bought after report dip.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion, not the hosts': an upgrade to buy from hold plus a Handelsbanken buy upgrade, and the stock rose 4%. The guest describes it as a stable dividend stock in consumer staples, which retail investors bought on the post-report dip.

#### Sell Triggers

- further negative earnings surprise

> *"sitt råd för dagligvarubolaget Axfood till köp från behåll"*

---

### 🟢 HEM — Hemnet | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Morgan Stanley upgraded to overweight from equal weight.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion only (Morgan Stanley upgrade); the hosts gave no view of their own.

> *"bostadsplattformen Hemnet höjts till övervikt från jämvikt av Morgan Stanley"*
